comment: This is the MASTER SCHEMA for the School Wiki / Heritage Hub. Use this as the blueprint for all 18 programs.

foundation.briefHistory: Founded in 1871 as Alcorn University, it is the oldest public historically black land-grant institution in the United States.
famousFirsts: First black land-grant institution in the nation.
Hiram R. Revels, the first African American to serve in the U.S. Senate, was its first president.

identity.colorsDescription: Purple and Gold represents the royal heritage and excellence of the institution.

landmarkSpots.significance: A ceremonial entrance for graduating seniors.
